runtime_binding.codex: Generated .codex/agents/*.toml files leave model and model_reasoning_effort unset so Codex can resolve each from the spawn, agent defaults, parent, and host policy; they request only a read-only filesystem sandbox.
runtime_binding.claude: Generated .claude/agents/*.md files use model: inherit with Read, Grep, Glob and plan permission defaults, subject to organization, invocation, environment, and parent-permission precedence.
runtime_binding.model_policy_json: Neither host consumes this file automatically. It documents the non-interference and evaluation policy only.
